mostWorthwhile.text: Following ADH to the collecting ducts was most worthwhile: it showed how a signal changes water recovery and the amount left in urine.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the brain-to-blood route felt somewhat repetitive after ADH had already been released into the blood, although it clarified the physical connection.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the concentrated sample and sensors produced blood carrying ADH directly, before the separate hormone route was assembled.

arbitrary.text: Assembling the hormone route after seeing the same release occur felt slightly out of sequence, though its purpose was explained.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it introduced a new relationship or decision. This chapter’s cause-and-effect sequence was clear, though most combinations were predictable from the item descriptions.
